A '''compound of five tetrahemihexahedra''' is a [[uniform polyhedron compound]] and a symmetric arrangement of five [[tetrahemihexahedron|tetrahemihexahedra]]. It could be also called a hemirhombichiricosahedron. It is [[Chirality (mathematics)|chiral]] with [[icosahedral symmetry]] ('''I''').

== Related polyhedra ==
[[File:5 thah in icosidodecahedron.png|thumb|150px|right|Five tetrahemihexahedra in an icosidodecahedron]]
Its [[convex hull]] is an [[icosidodecahedron]]. Hence it is a faceting of an [[icosidodecahedron]], shown at left. It shares its edges and triangular faces with the [[compound of five octahedra]].
